Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) is a Danish organization that serves as the technical and knowledge-based driving force behind the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] [^src1]. Operating through its Knowledge Center (RKKP's Videncenter), the organization is the official publisher of the database's annual reports and is directly responsible for preparing the underlying analyses [^src1]. The 2023 annual report, which evaluates treatment pathways for children and adolescents with ADHD from April 1, 2023, to March 31, 2024, was authored by RKKP and subsequently audited and commented on by the database's steering group [^src1]. 

As the managing and administering body for the database's analytical output, RKKP oversees the evaluation of systemic challenges in Danish child and adolescent psychiatry, tracking metrics such as rising waiting times, registration deficiencies, and regional disparities [^src1] [^src2]. However, the organization explicitly delineates its administrative boundaries, noting that the specific results and feedback found in the "Regional Comments" section of the annual report fall outside the direct purview and responsibility of RKKP [^src2]. For operational coordination and inquiries regarding the database, the organization's designated contact person is quality consultant [[malene-tousgaard-foget-oestergaard|Malene Tousgaard Foget Østergaard]] [^src1].

The organization's procedural workflow for the 2023 annual report included a formal consultation period to gather feedback from regional stakeholders. The report was sent out for consultation among regions and departments on December 4, 2024, and the hearing process officially concluded on January 17, 2025 [^src2].
